title: ot-cres: optimal-transport-based cell resampling for negative event weights
description: Code accompanying Optimal-Transport-Based Cell Resampling for Negative and Pathological Event Weights (arXiv:2607.08723). Cell resampling of negatively weighted Monte Carlo events using the Energy Mover's Distance and its spectral variant as the metric, plus the Cross-Section Mover's Distance (XMD) as an unbinned measure of reweighting bias. Supported by the U.S. Department of Energy, Office of Science, Office of High Energy Physics under Award Number DE-SC0026285, and by the National Science Foundation under Cooperative Agreement PHY-2019786 (IAIFI).
